name: RenoDX HDR
author: ShortFuse and the RenoDX team
description:
HDR for games that never had it, or better HDR than their own.
1. Needs an HDR display, with HDR on in Windows.
2. New here? Open the Setup tab first.
3. Install, then pick Its Games: each game gets its own mod.

games.name: ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON

targetGames.name: steam_1091500
notes: Graphics > Advanced > Color Precision: set it to High, or the picture looks washed out.
Video > HDR Mode: HDR10 PQ or HDR10 scRGB (HDR must be on in the game).
Video > HDR settings (Z key) > Tone-Mapping Midpoint: 1. HDR10 PQ Saturation: 0.
Set Maximum Brightness in the game and Peak Brightness in RenoDX to the same value.
Still washed out? Turn off Auto HDR for this game: Windows Settings > Display > Graphics > Cyberpunk 2077.
The mod is a work in progress. Full guide: hdrmods.com/Cyberpunk

targetGames.name: steam_1245620
notes: Easy Anti-Cheat stops the mod from loading.
The card starts this game offline, without anti-cheat, while it uses the RenoDX mod (the Offline chip on its row). Online play is off then.
Want to play online? Click Offline on the row to turn it off. RenoDX does not load online.
To play online in 3D, use the Standard ReShade build. SuperDepth3D still works there.

options.label: HDR Mods
options.description:
HDR for games that never had it, or better HDR than their own.
1. Needs an HDR display, with HDR on in Windows.
2. New here? Open the Setup tab first.
3. Install, then pick Its Games: each game gets its own mod.

options.label: Setup
options.description:
Do this once:
1. HDR: GPU Selector ticks the HDR box of each game you pick, so Windows HDR turns on when it starts.
2. Turn OFF Auto HDR in Windows and RTX HDR in the NVIDIA app. With them on, the picture looks washed out.
3. On the ReShade card, pick ReShade 6.8.0 or newer and the Add-on build.
4. Turn on Inject Mode (the syringe button).
5. Press Install Add-ons. Pick Its Games when it asks.
6. Press Play next to a game. In ReShade (Home key), open Add-ons > RenoDX to set the brightness.
7. RenoDX mods change often. Press Reinstall Add-ons now and then to get the newest builds.

options.label: Game Notes
options.description:
Notes for all games:
1. On the HDR Mods tab, press Notes under a game to read its own notes.
2. Elden Ring Nightreign is online only, so it is not on this card.
3. All these games are DirectX. The card locks GL and VK off for them.
4. Washed out? Turn off Auto HDR in Windows and RTX HDR in the NVIDIA app.
